meta.source: ufcstats.com via Greco1899/scrape_ufc_stats (data/raw/*.csv snapshot); built by tools/build_db.py

notes.S: sums decayed by 0.5^(days before snapshot / half_life); C: career sums. Both cover UFC fights with round stats; record, n_fights and ko_losses cover every UFC bout
notes.ctrl: ufcstats control seconds count clinch control as well as ground control
notes.results: ko_* include doctor and corner stoppages; DQ wins and losses are in record.dq_w/dq_l only
notes.ko_losses: career KO/TKO losses by strikes or corner stoppage (doctor stoppages excluded)
notes.pace: sig landed per minute by round in 5-round fights relative to round 1, weights = minutes; 3-round fights (rounds 1-3) when no 5-round fight of his reached round 2. pace3/pace3_w: the 3-round curve on its own (shrink toward priors pace3 for 3-round bouts)
notes.r5_min_k: extra keys beyond the spec list: minutes in round k of 5-round fights (pace denominators)
notes.division: most frequent division (catch/open weight ignored) over the 3 years before the snapshot, else career
notes.title: championship bouts (undisputed, interim, superfight); TUF / Road to UFC tournament finals are not titles
notes.tott: height/reach/stance/dob come from the tott row carrying the fighter's name, else the row under his ufcstats id; tott_distrusted rows were dropped (attributes null); tott_unverified rows carry another name and were kept only because the weight fits the fighter's division
notes.priors: live league rates from fights since 2018-01-01; a group with fewer than 20 stat fights borrows another group's rates (field `fallback`)
notes.eras: pre-2001 weight-class names are ufcstats' labels as scraped (e.g. 1997-2000 'Lightweight' was 170 lb or under); no roster or backtest fighter is affected
